 Registrar's order with  Signatures  WPCRL No. 1804 of 2025  Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Shakib Husain, learned counsel for the Petitioners.
2. Mr. S. S. Chauhan, learned D.A.G. assisted by Mr. Vikash Uniyal, learned Brief Holder for the State.
3. Mr. Rajat Mittal, learned counsel for the Caveator through V.C.

4. The present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India is filed by the Petitioners to quash the impugned FIR dated 13.12.2025 registered as FIR/Case Crime No.409 of 2025, for the offence punishable under Sections 120-B, 420, 467, 468, 471, 504 & 506 of IPC, at Police Station Nehru Colony, District Dehradun.

Along with the present petition, Petitioners filed stay application seeking arrest stay in connection with the abovementioned F.I.R.
5.

6. Admit.
7. Objections, if any, to be filed by the Respondents within a period of three weeks.
8.

In the interregnum, it is directed that the investigation shall proceed but the Petitioner shall not be arrested by the police in connection with the impugned FIR dated 13.12.2025 registered as FIR/Case Crime No.409 of 2025, for the offence punishable under Sections 120-B, 420, 467, 468,
471, 504 & 506 of IPC, at Police Station Nehru Colony, District Dehradun.
However, they will continue to cooperate with the Investigating Officer of the case and shall remain present, as and when required for production of documents and for recording of their statements.
10. Stay Application (IA No.01 of 2025) stands disposed of.

(Ashish Naithani, J.) 02.01.2026 Akash WPCRL/1804/2025 on 2 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/7025585/
